Respond in this EXACT JSON format (no other text):
{
  "summary": "2-3 sentence overview of what happened in this activity unit",
  "actions": ["key action 1", "key action 2"],
  "learnings": ["insight or lesson learned"],
  "significance": 5,
  "themes": ["topic1", "topic2"],
  "entities": [
    {
      "type": "decision",
      "name": "short canonical name",
      "content": "1-3 sentence description with enough context to recall later",
      "relationships": [
        {"to": "other entity name", "relation": "part_of"}
      ]
    }
  ]
}

RULES:
- significance is 1-10 (1=trivial, 5=normal, 8+=major milestone)
- themes are 1-3 word topic tags
- actions are specific: "committed migration engine", not "wrote code"
- learnings are insights, not descriptions: "FTS5 requires sync triggers", not "worked on FTS5"
- entities are durable things worth remembering across sessions: people mentioned, projects discussed, decisions made, tools introduced, patterns observed, lessons learned, hard facts. NOT every noun — only what an agent would want to recall weeks later.
- entity type MUST be one of: fact, person, project, tool, pattern, decision, lesson
- entity name is short and canonical (the form you would use to refer back to it)
- entity content captures enough context to ground a future recall (not just the name)
- relationship "to" references another entity by its name (must match one in this same entities array or a prior digest)
- relation MUST be one of: related_to, built_by, learned_from, depends_on, supersedes, contradicts, part_of, used_in, knows_about, caused, verified_by
- omit the entities array entirely or use [] if nothing in this activity unit is worth durable memory
